title: Auditing Cross-Lingual Fairness in Language Model Watermarking

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the detection performance (TPR, FPR, AUC) and generation quality preservation (MAUVE, BERTScore, reference perplexity) of LLM text watermarking schemes across 11 different languages, and quantifying cross-language disparity using generalized-entropy decomposition over a typological family partition.
